250-779-1479-4693-8338.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4693-8338.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-4693-8338.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

997-3197-4153--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2897-4890.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2897-4890.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dack's Duplicate and Gigantoplasm each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2897-4890.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

4050-5751-5763-7396.description:
Cast Circle of the Land Druid from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {1}{G} and discarding a land card.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
When Circle of the Land Druid enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the creature token and Circle of the Land Druid, adding {1}{G}.
When Circle of the Land Druid dies, its second ability triggers, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3490-4289-7075-7295.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4289-7075-7295.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

465-803-3742-4251-4742.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

628-3967-7199.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Slumbering Walker.
When Slumbering Walker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4050-4352-6972--112.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Maulfist Squad.
When Maulfist Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Maulfist Squad enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
4050-4352-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Maulfist Squad's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1978-4241-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least three.
1978-4241-4306.description:
Animate Nyx Lotus using Karn.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {3}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

101-4067-6281-6893.notablePrerequisites: The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
101-4067-6281-6893.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding at least twenty {U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Vampire Charmseeker.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Vampire Charmseeker that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vampire Charmseeker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat.

1681-4140-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Twilight Shepherd.
When Twilight Shepherd dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Giada.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2060-2744-3327-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
2060-2744-3327-6797.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

3967-4112-4375.description:
Cast Sharuum either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{W}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Technomancer.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Technomancer.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3497-4484-4871-5147-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
3497-4484-4871-5147-5643.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
3497-4484-4871-5147-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
3497-4484-4871-5147-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2060-3398-6599.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Maester Seymour triggers, putting at least seven +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability seven times by removing seven +1/+1 counters from it, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

1399-1606-2404-3457.easyPrerequisites:
Ley Weaver does not have summoning sickness
Seeker of Skybreak does not have summoning sickness.
1399-1606-2404-3457.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

1808-2292-2837.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1808-2292-2837.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first Eloise trigger, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Resolve the second Eloise trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1308-2457-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating six 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

263-1462-2351.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card during an opponent's turn.
263-1462-2351.description:
Draw a card during an opponent's turn.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, Setessan Champion triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1770-2034-3089-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar five times by sacrificing five Myrs, adding ten {C}.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing a Myr, returning Myr Battlesphere to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1558-1991-3263.notablePrerequisites: Tana has power five or greater, does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1558-1991-3263.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tana.
Tana triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Saprolings, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

579-2661-2816.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Gwenna.
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
579-2661-2816.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding four mana of any color(s) that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Activate Gwenna by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1283-1358-3525.notablePrerequisites: Chromatic Orrery does not have summoning sickness.
1283-1358-3525.description:
Activate Sydri by paying {U}, causing Chromatic Orrery to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying {1}{U}{U}, enchanting Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat from step 2.

413-2730-5145.notablePrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Archon of Falling Stars.
413-2730-5145.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping and sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Kaya's Ghostform and Archon of Falling Stars triggers.
Resolve the Kaya's Ghostform trigger, returning Archon of Falling Stars to the battlefield.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars' trigger, returning Kaya's Ghostform to the battlefield and attached to Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Blasting Station's ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
